title: Space bounds the work-tape window
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $t,s$ be natural numbers. If the total number of distinct work-tape cells visited by the computation of $M$ on $x$ through step $t$ is at most $s$, then at every time $u\le t$ each work-tape head is at a position of absolute value at most $s$, and every cell at an integer position of absolute value greater than $s$ is blank on every work tape.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
